# Datamining: Season 18 (all rewards) PTS Patch 08/09/2024

![Datamining: Season 18 (all rewards) PTS Patch 08/09/2024](/uploads/388_blog-teaser-template.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

**[Update 08/19/2024]** More Roadside Warrior pictures, new white Persian rug and Skyline Valley snow globe display case

This data mining contains the upcoming Season 18 rewards that are currently included in the August 9, 2024 patch on the PTS. Rewards may vary from this preview upon live release.

Season 18 will be available on the live servers from **September 3rd, 2024**.

(See also: Progress bar in the head of the website)
